dependency_edges.handoff: Distance influence and standardized elevation feed AHP habitat weighting.
The weighted current-nest surface feeds next-year spread.
The labeled multi-source image corpus feeds ResNet candidates and the binary downgrade.
The image target score feeds report credibility.
Current confirmed/nest distances feed the near-report branch.
Future-nest distance feeds the mid/near branches.
New expert-labeled images trigger CNN refresh.
New confirmed outcomes trigger spatial updates.
Verified sightings from the triage workflow supply ordered times.
Current and future maps feed search and beekeeper communication.
Queue groups and paired ranks feed agency handling advice.
The survival indicator feeds the interface state and candidate victory review.
